arts_domain.note: A sealed black dome with a staring eye: a closed field, or Red Moon Reverie. Open to any world.

arts_push.note: A sphere of force that blasts everything away (Cloudburst; also a Smash air-pressure blast). Open to any world.

ki_lightning_hand.note: The Shrike Bolt / Sickle Bolt: lightning chirping in one hand.

ki_spiral.note: The Senpugan: a spinning sphere driven from the palm.

saga_bigpunch.note: One punch, a colossal cone of air pressure: Ippon's Clean Slate, Full Beam's Foghorn Blast, Madake's Autumn Stag. Shonen-wide, open to any world.

will_sovereign.note: Crimson Command itself: the manga flash, black-red lightning and a ring of will that cracks the floor.

will_quakebubble.note: Haldor's quake: a bubble of cracked air round the fist, shattered like glass.

will_toonrubber.note: SUNRISE's toon ascension: bouncing cel clouds, a rubber shell and a sunburst.

will_frostaura.note: Orbiting ice shards and a frosted floor: any ice user awakened.

will_voltaura_a.note: A blue plasma skin with crawling ridges: reads as Setsu's SETSUNA.

will_voltaura_b.note: A cage of yellow lightning bars re-striking on twos.

will_voltaura_c.note: A violet lightning crown studded with spinning drum-rings: Adad's thunder drums.

will_steamaura.note: Toon steam boiling off a red-hot body: the inner gates, a body heating up.

will_blackflameaura.note: Ink-black flame with violet and crimson rims that stays black in daylight.

colossus_spiritarmor.note: A translucent purple armoured giant built rib by rib: Shiden's Guardian.

colossus_hundredpalm.note: Bonsho's golden many-armed statue: its palm.

colossus_flamefist.note: A giant fist of banded toon fire punched down the line: Kagari's Taimatsu.

colossus_moltenfist.note: A giant magma-veined rock fist from the sky: Shakugo's Final Sentence: Brimstone Rain.

colossus_glacierdrop.note: A giant faceted ice block dropped on a zone, ringed with frost spikes.

colossus_thundercloud.note: A boiling cel thundercloud firing forked strikes: Sorayomi's Storm Warning, Adad's Firmament Fall.

colossus_thunderhound.note: A hound of lightning galloping down the line: Shirokane's lightning beast.

colossus_pressurepillar.note: Pressure released to the sky as a flame-shaped pillar: a Unsealed coming out.

edge_petalswarm.note: Thousands of pink petal-blades: Shidare's Steel Petal Cut scattering.

edge_energyclaw.note: Five energy talons raked down from the sky: Irbis's Avalanche Talons.

edge_blackcrescent.note: A pure-black crescent with a white rim, the world drained to black: Nigo's Nightfang in its final form.

edge_onislash.note: A flame-fringed demon mask rising behind the swing: Kenzo's RAKSHASA.

edge_scythe.note: A pale spectral scythe reaping almost a full circle.

edge_chainsaw.note: Kuzu's chainsaw bar growing from the forearm and grinding in.

edge_firearrow.note: A drawn bow glyph and a blazing arrow that bursts in a cel fire blast.

edge_fingerbeam.note: A needle-thin fingertip ray: Jinlin's Pearl Needle, Senko's finger laser.

edge_heartbeam.note: Basilissa's heart fruit: a ray of spiralling hearts that turns the target to stone.

edge_palmblast.note: Palm explosions walking down the line hand after hand: Pyroclast's blasts.

seal_eboncoffin.note: Shiun's BLACK CONFESSIONAL: a black casket of crawling script, spears driven through.

seal_stringcage.note: Strappado's Big Top: glowing strings fall into a dome that contracts.

seal_hexwall.note: A hexagon-cell wall that stops shots: a ward.

seal_trigrams.note: Suzuran's palm flurry: the diagram, then doubling volleys.

seal_shrinedomain.note: Magatsu's Mirror Mere: the floor drowns crimson, the horned shrine heaves up and slashes.

seal_timestop.note: MIDNIGHT / HUSH: a colour-inverted sphere and a grey, stopped world.

seal_elasticstrand.note: Unari's elastic: a pink strand that sticks, goes taut and snaps back.

seal_sproutarms.note: Psyche's blooming arms: flowers open and arms sprout to clutch.

seal_tentacles.note: Rakucho's tendrils tendril: segmented crimson tentacles from the back.

seal_ghostrush.note: A spectral double rises behind and rains ghost fists: a spirit-style rush. Draws copies of the caster only.

seal_pull.note: Amagoi's pull: a gravity well in the palm hauls the target in.

seal_teleportmark.note: Minase's Relay Leap: a seal-tagged kunai, then a blink to it. The engine moves the fighter.

seal_grapple.note: Grapple Rig: wires bite, gas jets fire, a high arc and a spinning cut. The engine moves the fighter.

seal_cursemark.note: A seal at the neck and black flame marks crawling over the skin: Shiden's seal mark (his early look).

seal_snowcompass.note: Shijima's First Carol: Snow Halo: a snowflake circle on the floor, ice erupting along it.
